After breakfast, begin the transfer to the mountainous Chiriquí region.

The drive to Boquete takes approximately 1.5 hours.

As you climb, the air becomes cooler and coastal scenery gives way to flowering gardens and coffee plantations.

Accommodation at Panamonte Inn & Spa.

A coffee tour is scheduled for the afternoon.

The tour visits a Geisha coffee plantation.

This variety is considered one of the world's most famous and expensive coffees.

The region's altitude, volcanic soils, cool climate and humid air create favourable conditions for growing high-altitude coffee.

This is a group tour.

The tour is conducted in English.
